overall.skip_reason: Backend (localhost:3001) and Frontend (localhost:5173) unreachable at audit time

escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker crafts a Handlebars template with AST-type confusion or prototype pollution payload. If the backend renders user-supplied templates, this executes arbitrary JavaScript with Node.js process privileges.
escalations.fix: npm update handlebars (to >=4.7.9) in Backend workspace

escalations.title: Vitest Arbitrary File Read + RCE when UI Server Running
escalations.exploit_scenario: When vitest --ui is running, any attacker on the network can read arbitrary files and execute code in the test runner's Node.js context. Zero authentication required.
escalations.fix: npm update vitest vite (vitest >=3.2.6, vite >=5.5.10) in Frontend workspace

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution via Malicious .proto Parsing
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker provides a crafted .proto file or JSON descriptor. When the Orchestrator deserializes it, protobufjs code generation executes injected payload. Full RCE with process privileges.
escalations.fix: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update protobufjs (>=7.5.5). Note: platform/ is solo-session only per CLAUDE.md.

p2_findings.title: GET /api/search route not registered — 5 tests failing, DependencyPicker 404
p2_findings.detail: FR-dependency-search requires a cross-entity typeahead search endpoint. The service logic exists but the route is never mounted in app.ts. Five tests in tests/routes/search.test.ts confirm the 404. DependencyPicker modal is broken at runtime.
p2_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts with GET /api/search?q= filtering non-deleted work items by title/description. Register in app.ts as app.use('/api', searchRouter).

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer only checks most-recent plan — FR-dependency-* unguarded
p2_findings.detail: Enforcer auto-selects most-recently-modified requirements.md in Plans/. FR-dependency-* (16 requirements) including FR-dependency-search (5 failing tests) is never checked. CI gives a false green.
p2_findings.recommendation: Run enforcer against both plan files in CI, or add glob mode to check all Plans/**/requirements.md files.

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF injection via crafted filenames
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update form-data (to >=4.0.6) in all workspaces.

p2_findings.title: Vite dev server HMR access control bypass
p2_findings.note: Resolved together with DEP-002 (same package update)
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update vite (to >=5.5.10) in Frontend workspace. Resolved as part of DEP-002 fix.

p2_findings.title: brace-expansion exponential expansion DoS
p2_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix in Backend workspace to patch transitive brace-expansion.

p2_findings.title: js-yaml quadratic merge-key DoS
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update js-yaml (to >=3.14.3 or 4.x) in Backend workspace.

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp route-matcher ReDoS via crafted URL
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update in Orchestrator workspace to patch transitive path-to-regexp. Note: platform/ is solo-session only.
